connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package github. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the abhishekkumar2021 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN

env.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OAuth App client id (public) to enable the device-flow login.

env.name: GITHUB_READONLY
env.description: Set to 1 or true to disable issue-creating/commenting tools.
